scope: Compare the AC1027+ AcDs DataStorage data-start logic with ODA v5.4.1 and current open-source peer reports; refine the existing 3D implementation plan without claiming a local runtime reproduction.

method.authoritativeSpecification: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 24.2.2.1-24.2.2.3
method.evidenceRule: ODA field definitions govern local DWG layout. Peer discussions and PRs identify test cases and stage boundaries but do not override the specification or establish a libdxfrw runtime defect.

evidence.observed: The segment header's objectDataAlignmentOffset gives the data-segment stream position in 16-byte units relative to the segment start. Data-index local offsets are relative to that data-start marker; each record begins at the marker plus its local offset.
doesNotEstablish: the behavior of libdxfrw on every real-world producer variant
ACIS/SAB body validity or geometry semantics
evidence.planUse: Use the checked header field as the data-start anchor and retain the existing per-record segment-span and Blob01 bounds. Resolve the last-record maximum-span expression using the specification's stated coordinate origins before changing it.

evidence.observed: readSegments stores objectDataAlignmentOffset from the segment header at offset +36. readDataRecords does not consume it; it derives dataRegionBase by counting packed record headers and rounding the computed position to a 16-byte boundary.
evidence.status: Source/spec mismatch confirmed; local failing input or generated red vector not yet run.
evidence.planUse: Add PAR-124/P1 under the existing PAR-07/S8.3 owner. First create a minimal generated in-memory vector where the header-defined marker differs from the count-and-rounding estimate. Only change production logic after record handles, exact payloads, and the following sentinel assert the expected outcome.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp Prototype1b parsing and attachment stages
evidence.observed: PR #1154 merged a full Prototype1b section reader on 2026-07-28; the related #1156 was closed after its author reported validating the end-to-end DataStorage payload path on an R2013+ corpus. In the discussion, initial payload-count/hash deltas were later narrowed: some compared unreferenced/stale section records with linked entity payloads, while a parsed-but-unattached section payload left only a 154-byte inline entity stub. Contributors subsequently reported that referenced per-handle payloads matched after correcting the data-start anchor and using the DataStorage resolver. These measurements are contributor reports and were not reproduced in this review.
doesNotEstablish: independent verification of the peer corpus or implementation
all producer variants or stale-section behavior
ACIS shape semantics, native acceptance, or local libdxfrw failure
evidence.planUse: Compare referenced records by entity handle and exact payload. Report orphaned/unreferenced segment entries, entity attachment, carrier emission, and geometry as separate stages. Do not compare raw section record count with entity count.

evidence.observed: Issue #1195 reports that ACadSharp 3.4.9 omitted 3DSOLID/REGION entities from DWG-to-DXF output, including solids inside blocks. PR #1240 proposes DXF dependent-entity output and DWG ModelerGeometry serialization, but remains open and undeployed in the reviewed snapshot.
evidence.planUse: Keep modelspace, solid-only block, and mixed 2D/3D owner inventories in the existing composed writer gate. An open PR is not a runtime comparator.

vectorRequirements: header-defined marker intentionally different from packed-header-count rounding
variable header counts and filler lengths around 16-byte boundaries
exact payload association and following-record sentinel
invalid before-segment, beyond-segment, and overflowing anchors
separate assertions for DataStorage record resolution and entity attachment
implementationReadiness.validationCadence: Build the touched strict target and run the existing graph-preservation CTest plus diff check. Do not run the full suite after this slice; retain larger ACIS, peer, and native checks for their existing composed gates.
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: Use from-scratch in-memory vectors. Do not download or commit DWG/DXF/SAB samples.
